description.value: Seasonal RV resort on Lake Windermere with a marina, beach, and full hookups — only 3 overnight hookup sites exist for the general public (minimum 2–7 nights, no tents permitted), making drop-in access for cycle tourists unlikely.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Shadybrook Resort and Marina is an active waterfront RV resort on Lake Windermere at 1783 Victoria Avenue, Windermere, BC, with contact details not present in OSM. The resort is overwhelmingly seasonal-RV-focused with only 3 full-service overnight sites open to the general public, and a 7-night minimum stay in high season substantially limits utility for touring cyclists. Amenities including showers, laundry, potable water via an onsite treatment plant, ice from the marina store, and online reservations are all confirmed from the website; hiker/biker-specific sites, cyclist discounts, camping fuel, and most cycling-specific amenities are not mentioned.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Shadybrook Resort' but the business operates as 'Shadybrook Resort and Marina'
